n: Wireless Passive Infrared Occupancy Sensor, infiNET EX® (GLS-OIR-CSM-EX-BATT)
d: GLS-OIR-CSM-EX-BATT Wireless Passive Infrared Occupancy Sensor, infiNET EX®, Battery-Powered

specs.label: Coverage Pattern
specs.value: 360 degrees (half mask and perforated mask included)

specs.label: Major Motion Area
specs.value: 150 to 500 square feet (13.9 to 46.4 square meters)

specs.label: Minor Motion Area
specs.value: 0 to 150 square feet (0 to 13.9 square meters)

specs.label: Battery
specs.value: (1) Ultralife® U9VL-J-P 9 Volt 1200 mAh lithium disposable battery (included)

specs.label: RF Transceiver
specs.value: infiNET EX 2-way RF, 2.4 GHz ISM Channels 11-26 (2400 to 2483.5 MHz), default channel 15; IEEE 802.15.4 compliant

specs.label: Range (typical)
specs.value: 50 ft (15 m) to gateway or nearest mesh network device(s), subject to site-specific conditions and individual device capabilities, range between floors or ceilings is limited to one level

specs.label: Gateway
specs.value: Requires an infiNET EX gateway or Crestron Pyng control hub (sold separately)

specs.label: Construction mounting
specs.value: Ceiling surface mount, 3 inch (76 mm) screw spacing
